Dear Len, List,

Many thanks for the advice. I have also just been told an alternative =
method for Distance 3.5 which appears to work. If the time field (survey =
number / month etc.) is entered as a line transect field rather than an =
observation field then the post stratification on unequal surveys =
appears to work - so when importing data the line transect fields are =
occupied by a label, a length and also a survey number / observer etc. =
or anything else that applies to the whole transect. Observation fields =
are then only used for data that vary during the transect - species, sex =
etc. This seems to solve the problem...

Tom
